svg.aria-label: Growth-curve analysis: doubling exponents, 32-bit nonce inversion times, and AICc model selection across 7 SAT tracks

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Post-Knee Asymptotic Linear Fits, 32-Bit Nonce Times & Sub-Exponential Test
Log-linear T(k) = a·2^(αk) skipping low-k floors (Frob k≥22, CaDiCaL/Kissat k≥10, dense k≥12, CMS k≥2) · 64R SHA-256 (1C)
A. Post-Knee Log-Linear Exponent α (b = 2^α / bit)
Solid bar: post-knee OLS · Diamond: Tobit right-censored MLE (+3 T/Os)
B. Full 32-Bit Nonce Inversion Time T(32) [log scale]
Measured 1C (3.3–4.2 min) vs. Post-Knee Tobit CDCL (5.2 d – 5.3 yr)
C. Post-Knee Sub-Exponential Test: ΔAICc = AICc(M0) − AICc(Mⱼ) (Values > +2 Required to Beat Pure Log-Linear M0)
Pure log-linear M0 wins 6/7 post-knee tracks outright; CMS (.xcnf) +4.8‡ is solely the k=2 Gauss jump (0.30s → 5.73s; k≥3 gives −6.5)
*Measured 1C T(32) · †Post-knee Tobit (+3 T/Os) · ‡k=2 Gauss step · bars ≤−10 clamped
